title: Thin, print only on one side, wrinkled .
text:
Thin, print only on one side, wrinkled .. I expected dishtowels as it said! There not absorbent at all.
The print is only on one side!
There Thin, wrinkled up when I took them out of a warm dryer ,using a dryer sheet.
I would not recomend these
